scripts.setup: npm install --prefix contracts && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/setup.js
scripts.test: npm test --prefix contracts && npm test --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n chain,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run chain" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy:local --prefix contracts && npm run server" "npm run client"
